questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, slow down, look both ways, and listen for trains. Be ready to stop if a train is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if you see one coming. Never try to outrun a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign tells you there is a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings alerts you to a side road intersection ahead. Stay alert for traffic from the side road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared to stop if the light is flashing.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: A yellow sign showing a traffic signal tells you a traffic signal is coming up. Get ready to respond to it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic signals are coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a side road intersects ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to safely allow other vehicles to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and stop if needed to let other vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians pass. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign shows you are near a school. Watch for children and stop if any are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services for drivers, such as rest areas, food, gas, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot turn right where this sign is posted. Turning right at this location is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn wagons, and farm equipment display this emblem. It warns other drivers that the vehicle travels at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Slow down in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits turns in the direction the arrow points. The arrow points right, so no right turns are allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign shows traffic moving to the right of an island or barrier. The road ahead is divided into separate lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns of a sharp turn. Slow down and be ready for a sudden change in direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn to go in the opposite direction. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic from another road is merging into your lane ahead. Be alert.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a sharp curve or a road that gets narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or before narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign marks a crosswalk where pedestrians cross. Watch for people crossing and let them pass safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws that you must follow. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs mark construction areas. Drive carefully and be ready for changes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs warn of school zones and school crossings. Stay alert and be prepared to stop when you see these signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs mean you are approaching or are in a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and obey posted speed limits in school zones.
